paper_title: Token-Level Uncertainty Estimation for Large Language Model Reasoning
caption: Left: Uncertainty estimations in different token decoding temperature . Right: Influence of token decoding temperature on uncertainty-based AUROC scores.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between decoding temperature and uncertainty estimations for different regions. The x-axis represents decoding temperature, labeled from 0.0 to 0.8, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents uncertainty, ranging from approximately 0.10 to 0.75, using a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.05. A red line, depicted as solid circles, represents the uncertainty estimation for Australia (AU), beginning at approximately 0.175 and increasing to approximately 0.20 at 0.8. A blue line, shown as solid line segments, represents the uncertainty estimation for Tunisia (TU), which initiates at approximately 0.150 and gradually increases to approximately 0.155 by 0.8. Lastly, a green line, indicated by solid line segments, represents the uncertainty estimation for Europe (EU), starting at approximately 0.125 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.13 throughout the range of the x-axis.
